title: Man wanted in fatal South Station stabbing arrested in Texas
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Crime Crime scene tape kept passengers away from the escalator where the stabbing occurred at South Station.
Lauren Albana/The Boston Globe An 18-year-old suspected of fatally stabbing a man at South Station in August has turned himself in to police in Texas, officials said.

Marico Levy of Aubrey, Texas, was charged in August with murder and assault and battery with a dangerous weapon in the fatal stabbing of Latavius Owens, 29, of Memphis, according to the Suffolk County District Attorney’s Office.
